triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Triage: lands in `area:ux` · `domain:ui` · `priority:p1` · Bug · `pm:queue` · size S.
Rationale: the p1 grade is the filer's and stays as set. The defect is in the console's selection-bar bulk executor and its result dialog: a per-record `type: 'flow'` dispatch reads a `200` with `data.status: "refused"` as success, and only one refusal message is shown. The row-menu path already handles a refusal, so the fix is to make the bulk path count refused runs apart and list each refusal message in the result dialog. Routed to repo:objectstack#3 (area:ux) by the maintainer's seat routing.

File surface (amended, replacing the claim's): `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` (`runBulkActionRecord` reads the refusal and hands it to the executor), `ui/packages/types/src/ui-action.ts` (one optional typed `ActionResult` member carrying the refusal message, plus one typed bulk-dispatch signal), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/flowLaunch.ts` (the refused arm sets the member), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx` (a bulk dispatch opens no `FlowRefusalNotice`; the row menu keeps its own), `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/hooks/useBulkExecutor.ts` and `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/BulkActionDialog.tsx` (refused rows are a third result category, each with its own message, and no retry is offered for them), their tests, the i18n packs if a string is added, and one changeset listing `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid` and `@object-ui/app-shell` (plus i18n if touched). `flowResponse.ts` (open PR #36845) and `ActionRunner.ts` (open draft PR #36919) stay read-only.
Container & model: `M`, effort high, tier default.
Clause-②: yes (seat ruling: the published `@object-ui/types` `ActionResult` gains a member; L1-a owes a lane-keep L2 review)
